column1: # CI guard registry (W0 fix-wave, Tier-1 #11 / D5.14).
# THE single registry of scripts/check-* guards. package.json's `check:all`
# (a second, stale, hand-synced copy) was deleted; scripts/run-verify-parallel.sh
# executes guards, and scripts/guard-self-test.sh consumes THIS file to
# self-test every scanner guard against known-bad/known-good fixtures under
# class: scanner   = greps/parses repo sources; MUST eventually carry fixtures
#                    (selftest yes|todo). A scanner guard with selftest=todo is
#                    tracked debt — the class that produced two permanently-
#        buildfresh = runs builds/regenerators and diffs outputs; self-tests
#                    don't apply (the build IS the test). exempt.
#        repostate = checks repo/file state (modes, symlinks, VERSION stamps);

column4: notes
not in verify CHECKS: runs directly as a test.yml verify-job step

conversation-formats + transcripts fixtures (all tokens); evals/ and docs/test-audit/ (real-entity tokens, V-12); GBRAIN_GUARD_ROOT seam; prints GBRAIN_CHECK_SKIPPED when none of the scanned paths exists or they hold no file
prints GBRAIN_CHECK_SKIPPED when git lists no file to scan
prints GBRAIN_CHECK_SKIPPED while docs/proposals/ is absent or holds no *.md
prints GBRAIN_CHECK_SKIPPED when test/ and evals/ hold no TypeScript file
prints GBRAIN_CHECK_SKIPPED when none of CLAUDE.md, docs/TESTING.md or the docs/architecture reference docs exist
tracked src, test and root text files end with a newline (guard fixtures excluded); GBRAIN_GUARD_ROOT seam scans with find; prints GBRAIN_CHECK_SKIPPED when no non-empty tracked text file is in scope

allowlist data file: check-test-isolation.allowlist; fixture mode (GBRAIN_GUARD_ROOT) lints *.test.fixture.ts (bad: R2, bad-r1: R1); prints GBRAIN_CHECK_SKIPPED when no non-serial unit test file exists
git index state check; prints GBRAIN_CHECK_SKIPPED when git lists no tracked file
committed per-file line ceilings (module-size-limits.tsv); growth + stale-ceiling + missing-row + new-file cap; prints GBRAIN_CHECK_SKIPPED while src/ has no source file and the TSV no row

W5 per-function line ratchet (TS compiler API): new >300-line function, growth, shrink-below-limit, stale slack, missing row, raise without issue/TODO id; baseline scripts/function-size-baseline.tsv keyed by path + name path; --transfer for verified move-only commits; prints GBRAIN_CHECK_SKIPPED while src/ has no source file and the baseline no row

W7 (refactor wave 1): retired contributor-workflow phrases (migrations array, two-engine SQL rule, CLI switch case, region policy, hand-synced schema text) and the vocabulary of the cut product (paths into the src tree, the embedded database engine, gbrain CLI commands, brain table names) fail in CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, docs/, skills/, scripts/, .github/ and package.json; historical records and the porting kit exempt; GBRAIN_GUARD_ROOT seam; bad-<location> fixtures; prints GBRAIN_CHECK_SKIPPED when none of the scanned paths exists

#5810: every tracked *.sh parses under bash 3.2 (real parser: GBRAIN_BASH32, stock macOS /bin/bash, or the digest-pinned bash:3.2 image); not in verify CHECKS or this self-test, which must not need Docker; its bad/good fixtures run in test/scripts/check-bash32.test.ts, mandatory in the test.yml verify-job step (GBRAIN_TEST_BASH32_REQUIRE=1)

CHANGELOG.md keeps every release heading origin/main has; reads the base ref from git (unit: test/scripts/check-changelog-headings.test.ts); prints GBRAIN_CHECK_SKIPPED when the base ref is unavailable locally or its CHANGELOG.md has no release heading
regenerate+diff of structural-suites.tsv (classify-tests.ts); the diff IS the self-test

runtime-reachability walk (static+dynamic relative imports) from the ENTRYPOINTS list + package.json exports; hard-fails untested orphans, requires a reasoned PERMITTED_TEST_ONLY entry per test-only module (stale entries fail); prints GBRAIN_CHECK_SKIPPED while src/ is empty; fixture root via argv/GBRAIN_GUARD_ROOT; knip v5 evaluated + rejected (crashes on repo layout — see script header)

TypeScript AST (CallExpression) scan of test/**/*.test.ts for no-op expect(true)/expect(1) placeholders; path+test+count allowlist (disabled in fixture mode); fixture root via argv/GBRAIN_GUARD_ROOT; in verify CHECKS; prints GBRAIN_CHECK_SKIPPED when test/ holds no *.test.ts file

manual per-PR discrimination helper (#3665): reverts named source files to their pre-fix state and runs the named test file to prove it fails without the fix — the test run IS the check; not in verify CHECKS or CI

D7 (GBRA-47): execution-gating process.env.GBRAIN_* reads in test/ and evals/ of names the operator-env preload strips (TS AST); policy shared with test/helpers/operator-env-policy.ts; prints GBRAIN_CHECK_SKIPPED when test/ and evals/ hold no TypeScript file
C2 (GBRA-47): weight-map entries naming missing files fail; unweighted share per lane warns, failing only on the scheduled run; prints GBRAIN_CHECK_SKIPPED when no lane has a test file
#6845: a file URL .pathname in test/ keeps %20 escapes; GBRAIN_GUARD_ROOT seam; skips test/fixtures/guards/; prints GBRAIN_CHECK_SKIPPED when test/ holds no source file outside the guard fixtures

Trunk Dynamic CI (docs/ci-event-parity.md#trunk-dynamic-ci): a trunk-io/dynamic-ci filter job runs only on pull_request in a workflow with that trigger, SHA-pinned, token from secrets.TRUNK_API_TOKEN, job-keys equal to its outputs; a gated job starts its if with !cancelled() && needs.<filter>.outputs.<key> != 'false' and checks each other need succeeded; merge and release aggregates are never gated; GBRAIN_GUARD_ROOT seam; bad-* fixtures cover a filter on every event, a dropped other-needs check and a top-level || past the gate; the step must carry continue-on-error: true; prints GBRAIN_CHECK_SKIPPED when .github/workflows holds no workflow file
